basic_details.job_title: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 41 Mukhya Mantri Fellow, Assistant Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Centre for Policy Research and Analysis at the Indian Institute of Management Shillong is filling 41 full-time contractual posts under the Mukhya Mantri Vikshit Arunachal Fellowship Programme (MMVAFP) of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh: 14 Mukhya Mantri Fellows at ₹70,000 and 27 Assistant Fellows at ₹60,000 a month (fixed honorarium). Indian citizens aged up to 35 years with a Master's degree in any discipline, with at least 60% marks in both undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, may apply online by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM (IST).

qualification.details: Domain knowledge or relevant experience in public policy, governance, development programmes, planning, economics, finance, social development or related areas. Graduation, postgraduation or professional exposure from premier institutions such as IITs, IIMs, ISB and TISS. Knowledge of project management and experience in implementation, monitoring or evaluation of Government schemes and development projects. Strong ICT and computer skills, including MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint; familiarity with MS Project or similar tools is an added advantage. Good analytical, research, report-writing, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

how_to_apply: Open the online application link given in the notice (see Important Links below).
Read the notification and complete all required fields.
Indicate your willingness to undertake assignments in any Department/District of Arunachal Pradesh during the contractual period.
Upload clear copies of the supporting documents.
Submit the application by 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM (IST). Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be entertained.

Applicants need a valid email address and mobile number, and must keep them active until the recruitment process is complete. All communications go to the contact details given in the application. For further information, the notice gives the email [email protected] and the phone number 0364-2308098. The postal address is Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Centre for Policy Research and Analysis, Indian Institute of Management Shillong, Umsawli, Shillong-793018, Meghalaya.
important_instructions: Candidates must have their own laptops for official work. The Dr. Kalam Centre will provide an orientation/capacity-building programme to selected candidates. The Government of Arunachal Pradesh will provide working space, internet facility and other necessary support as deemed appropriate by the Finance, Planning & Investment Department. Selected candidates must comply with the rules, instructions, work schedules and confidentiality requirements at their place of posting. Access to Government data is governed by the instructions of the supervising officers. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be shortlisted or called for interview. False statements, concealment of facts or forged documents may lead to rejection or termination of engagement. The Centre/IIM Shillong reserves the right to modify the recruitment schedule or process, shortlist candidates, or cancel the recruitment without assigning reasons. Canvassing in any form or bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will result in disqualification. No interim correspondence on selection will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre and the Programme
content_sections.text: The Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Centre for Policy Research and Analysis (Dr. Kalam Centre) is part of the Indian Institute of Management Shillong, Umsawli, Shillong, Meghalaya. The fellowship programme aims to bring young academic talent and professionals into the Government's planning, policy formulation, programme implementation, monitoring and evaluation. The notice says it is meant to strengthen the analytical and implementation capacity of the Finance, Planning & Investment Department and other Government offices. Selected candidates will be engaged by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and placed across its departments, verticals, divisions, units and District Planning Units, as per programme requirements.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 41 vacancies in total. The number of vacancies may vary depending on the requirements of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All requirements are counted as on the closing date of application, 30 November 2026. The same essential qualification applies to both posts; only the desirable experience differs. Applicants must be Indian citizens. Maximum age for both posts: 35 years as on 30 November 2026. The Government of Arunachal Pradesh may relax conditions other than the essential educational qualifications for deserving candidates, in accordance with the applicable programme provisions. The notice prints no category-wise age relaxation. Domain knowledge or relevant experience in public policy, governance, development programmes, planning, economics, finance, social development or related areas. Graduation, postgraduation or professional exposure from premier institutions such as IITs, IIMs, ISB and TISS. Knowledge of project management and experience in implementation, monitoring or evaluation of Government schemes and development projects. Strong ICT and computer skills, including MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint; familiarity with MS Project or similar tools is an added advantage. Good analytical, research, report-writing, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.desirable_experience: Minimum three (3) years of relevant work experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly fixed honorarium is ₹70,000 for Mukhya Mantri Fellows and ₹60,000 for Assistant Fellows. The notice names no allowances. The terms of engagement are: The engagement is full-time and contractual. The fellowship period is a minimum of twelve (12) months and shall not exceed two (2) years, subject to the terms of engagement and requirements of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. Fellows who do not complete the requisite period and assigned work may not be issued a fellowship/experience certificate, in accordance with the programme conditions. The engagement confers no right to claim regular appointment or absorption in the Government of Arunachal Pradesh or IIM Shillong.

content_sections.heading: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties for both Mukhya Mantri Fellows and Assistant Fellows. They support senior officers and the Finance, Planning & Investment Department, along with other duties assigned by the competent authority: Provide research, analytical and programme support to senior officers in the Office of the Hon'ble Chief Minister, Finance, Planning & Investment Department and other designated Government offices. Supplement the policy analysis and planning processes of the Finance, Planning & Investment Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. Undertake structured research to identify gaps in the design of Government programmes, schemes and implementation processes, and recommend measures for improvement. Collect, compile, validate and analyse quantitative and qualitative data relating to development programmes, projects and public service delivery. Prepare empirical analyses, policy briefs, background papers, project reports, presentations and other knowledge products to support evidence-based policy formulation. Assess the outcomes and impact of development works and projects initiated by the Government and examine challenges in project delivery and implementation. Support monitoring and evaluation of Government schemes, projects and initiatives, including tracking progress against agreed outputs and outcomes. Use appropriate digital tools and technology to improve office processes, project coordination, data management and governance practices. Work with District Planning Units under the supervision of the Deputy Commissioner/District Planning Officer and with designated verticals, divisions and units at the State headquarters. Submit a brief report/paper at the end of the assignment on the work undertaken, outputs delivered and learning gained, as required by the concerned Head of Vertical/Division/Unit. Selected candidates may be posted in any Department, District or designated office of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The competent authority decides posting and responsibilities based on programme requirements and the candidate's suitability. Those placed in District Planning Units work under the overall supervision of the concerned Deputy Commissioner/District Planning Officer. They may also be assigned to the Finance, Planning & Investment Department and other designated offices at the State headquarters. Heads of Verticals/Divisions/Units and the respective District authorities oversee work programme, outputs, attendance and performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice (see Important Links below). Read the notification and complete all required fields. Specify your area(s) of interest. Indicate your willingness to undertake assignments in any Department/District of Arunachal Pradesh during the contractual period. Upload clear copies of the supporting documents. Submit the application by 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM (IST). Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be entertained. Applicants need a valid email address and mobile number, and must keep them active until the recruitment process is complete. All communications go to the contact details given in the application. For further information, the notice gives the email [email protected] and the phone number 0364-2308098. The postal address is Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Centre for Policy Research and Analysis, Indian Institute of Management Shillong, Umsawli, Shillong-793018, Meghalaya.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a personal interview only. The stages are: Shortlisting: applications are screened against the essential eligibility criteria. If applications are large, the Centre may shortlist a reasonable number based on academic record, relevant experience, domain suitability and other benchmarks set by the screening committee. Personal interview: shortlisted candidates are invited for an in-person interview at IIM Shillong, Umsawli, Shillong, Meghalaya. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Document verification: candidates must produce original certificates and supporting documents at the time of interview or whenever required. Final selection: made on merit, based on the overall assessment in the personal interview and verification of eligibility and credentials. The decision of the Selection Committee/competent authority is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 41 vacancies: 14 Mukhya Mantri Fellows and 27 Assistant Fellows. The notice says the number may vary with the requirements of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM (IST). Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Mukhya Mantri Fellow and Assistant Fellow?
faq.answer: Both posts need a Master's degree in any discipline, with at least 60% marks in both undergraduate and postgraduate programmes from Institutes of National Importance or reputed/recognised Universities. Experience of three years (Mukhya Mantri Fellow) or two years (Assistant Fellow) is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on 30 November 2026, for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Mukhya Mantri Fellow and an Assistant Fellow?
faq.answer: A Mukhya Mantri Fellow gets a monthly fixed honorarium of ₹70,000 and an Assistant Fellow gets ₹60,000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the MMVAFP fellowship?
faq.answer: Apply online through the application link given in the notice. Fill all required fields, specify your area(s) of interest and willingness to work in any Department/District of Arunachal Pradesh, and upload clear copies of the supporting documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a personal interview only, held in person at IIM Shillong after shortlisting. Original documents are verified at the interview or whenever required, and the final selection is made on merit.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is full-time and contractual for a minimum of 12 months and not more than 2 years. It gives no right to regular appointment or absorption in the Government of Arunachal Pradesh or IIM Shillong.

faq.question: Q9. Where will selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: They may be posted in any Department, District or designated office of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, including District Planning Units and the State headquarters. The competent authority decides the posting.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need my own laptop?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have their own laptops for official work. The Government of Arunachal Pradesh will provide working space, internet facility and other necessary support.
